3. Make the script executable and then run it once so the directory tree and the log file are produced.

b. Move (not copy) every file in /home/user/datasets whose name ends in “.csv” into the …/csv directory and every file whose name ends in “.json” into the …/json directory.
containing EXACTLY two lines, each terminated by a single newline character, and nothing else.

python3 -c 'import re,sys
d=open('"'"'/home/user/dataset_summary.log'"'"').read()

ok=d.endswith('"'"'\n'"'"') and len(ls)==3 and re.fullmatch(r'"'"'csv\t[0-9]+\t[0-9]+'"'"',ls[0]) and re.fullmatch(r'"'"'json\t[0-9]+\t[0-9]+'"'"',ls[1])
